name: aurora-cloud-relay
description: Server-only bridge between VANTA desktop exe and YOUR OWN Telegram account (MTProto userbot) + WhatsApp. Holds platform connections online 24/7, relays events/actions, backs up sessions to the exe. No bot logic — the desktop exe is the brain. v2.1: pairing hardening (phone normalization, auto creds reset, fresh pairing codes).
